GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA
OFFICE OF THE STATE TAX OFFICER
CIRCULAR CIRCLE-09, PUNE ZONE

Show Cause Notice under Section 73 of the CGST / MGST Act, 2017
Reference No: SCN/MH/2023-24/606
Date: 18-09-2023

To,
M/s Vantage Logistics Pvt Ltd
GSTIN: 27IIIJJ1234I1Z9
Financial Year: 2022-23

1. WHEREAS, scrutiny of returns filed by you for FY 2022-23 was conducted by the undersigned under Section 61 of the CGST Act 2017.

2. GROUND I - GSTR-3B VS GSTR-2B ITC MISMATCH: Scrutiny reveals that Input Tax Credit of Rs. 1,50,000/- was availed by you in Form GSTR-3B for invoices that do not appear in your static GSTR-2B statement communicated under Section 16(2)(aa). As per Section 16(2)(aa), credit availed without GSTR-2B reflection is ineligible.

3. GROUND II - INTEREST ON DELAYED PAYMENT OF TAX: Taxpayer delayed filing GSTR-3B return for September 2022 by 30 days. The officer computed interest under Section 50 on the gross tax liability of Rs. 4,00,000/-, demanding interest of Rs. 5,918/-.

4. ACCORDINGLY, Ground I proposes disallowance of excess ITC under Section 16(2)(aa), and Ground II proposes interest demand under Section 50.

5. NOW THEREFORE, you are called upon to show cause why:
(a) Disallowed ITC of Rs. 1,50,000/- under Ground I should not be recovered under Section 73(1);
(b) Interest of Rs. 5,918/- under Ground II should not be recovered under Section 50;
(c) Penalty under Section 73(9) should not be levied.

6. You are required to submit your comprehensive reply on the GST portal within 30 days.
